title: Windthrow and Fern Understory Gap
description: One static woodland windthrow and understory-gap scene, zero new reusable models. Four entire qualified existing assets retain the complete upright low-fork canopy tree, uprooted rootplate-and-fallen-trunk, mature pinnate fern and compact emerging coiled fern crown. One low scene-only forest-earth floor supports all complete original ground interfaces. The fallen remnant is the central low barrier, standing canopy stays behind it, and two different whole understory forms flank a reserved clear foreground gap; no man-made soil-road modules or extra repeated trees. All original evaluated world geometry, complete oriented triangles and per-face opaque PBR remain unchanged at unit scale. Original hierarchy/normals are explicitly baked/recomputed. This is a visual habitat composition, not a measured regeneration process, ecological claim, collision/navigation, walkability or safety certification. One scene, zero new model count.
